description: This file defines the ConnectionId class, a Java representation of a connection identifier, including static factory methods, validation, and utility overrides.

classes.name: ConnectionId
classes.description: Immutable class representing a connection ID with validation, factory methods, and utility overrides.

methods.name: generateRandom
methods.description: Generates a random unique connection ID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionId from a CharSequence, returning the same instance if the input is already a ConnectionId.

methods.name: dummy
methods.description: Returns a dummy ConnectionId instance for non-use purposes.

methods.name: isDummy
methods.description: Checks if the current ConnectionId is the dummy ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the string representation of the ID.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the string representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the ConnectionId.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the ID string against a regex pattern; throws an exception if invalid.
